annotations.title: Fed liquidity: repo facilities, holdings, reserves

description: The Fed's footprint in the money markets: the overnight reverse repo facility's daily take-up and the standing repo facility's lending (New York Fed, its test trades kept apart), the Fed's securities holdings week by week with the pace they change by type, and its balance sheet: total assets, reserve balances, the TGA and net liquidity (assets less the TGA and the reverse repo). Each with changes over a week, four weeks and a year, a plain summary first; or any of them day by day or week by week. No key.

days.description: operations: business days shown, latest last; default 20.

view.description: overview (default): the latest of each with its changes; operations: the reverse repo and standing repo facilities day by day; holdings: the Fed's securities week by week; balance_sheet: total assets, reserves, the TGA, the reverse repo and net liquidity week by week.

weeks.description: holdings and balance_sheet: weeks shown, latest last; default 13.

name: fed_liquidity

outputSchema.description: summary is the latest in plain sentences; reverse_repo and standing_repo are the latest business day (billions of dollars) with recent context; holdings and balance_sheet are tables of a line, its level and its changes at the latest Wednesday. With view, rows are days or weeks (oldest first) in the order of columns.

title: Fed liquidity: repo facilities, holdings, reserves
